caption: The drawing depicts a female figure in profile facing to the right, dressed in a long, elaborate gown with a patterned fabric in shades of brown and beige. The gown features a fitted bodice, long sleeves with brown cuffs, and a long, voluminous skirt that extends out behind her, trimmed at the bottom with brown bands and ruffles. Along the back of the bodice and upper skirt, there are several small, round, red accents resembling buttons or decorative trim. The figure has light-colored hair styled in an elaborate, braided updo. She holds a brown rectangular object, possibly a fan or small clutch, in her left hand. The background is plain, off-white or cream-colored, with slight discoloration along the right edge. The name "Edith Townner" is written in cursive in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Doll - "Charlotte Blankenship"
